text: Constraining the citation weight parameter below one and enforcing row stochasticity through normalization guarantees that the citation weighted value vector exists, is unique, and converges, which resolves the instability of the original recursive valuation formula.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Evolution of Domain-Specific Reputation Systems From Binary Validation to Citation-Weighted Knowledge Attribution (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6192998

isBasedOn.name: Evolution of Domain-Specific Reputation Systems From Binary Validation to Citation-Weighted Knowledge Attribution

abstract: This theorem addresses the instability concern with the recursive formula in Calcaterra, Kaal, and Andrei (2018, 41). By constraining and ensuring row-stochasticity through normalization, we guarantee convergence, a crucial property for autonomous operation.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: citation weight parameter strictly less than one
contribution matrix normalized to be row stochastic
